# routeros_interface_wireguard_peers (Data Source)


Reads live WireGuard peer status from `/interface/wireguard/peers` using a narrow `.proplist` query that omits `private-key` and `preshared-key` on the wire and from the Terraform schema.

Returned attributes reflect the router state at the time of the Terraform read. A peer that has never completed a handshake reports `last_handshake = ""` (empty string).

---

## Example Usage
```terraform
data "routeros_interface_wireguard_peers" "wg0" {
  filter = {
    interface = "wg0"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Map of String) Additional request filtering options.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `peers` (List of Object) Live WireGuard peer status observations at the time of the Terraform read. Private keys and preshared keys are omitted from both the router projection and Terraform schema. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--peers))
